card.provider: 小米云服务 / Xiaomi Cloud (Mi Cloud Drive)
card.summary: 5G free, with 50G, 200G and 2048G paid tiers at 72, 252 and 816 yuan a year

record.provider: 小米云服务 / Xiaomi Cloud (Mi Cloud Drive)

free_tier.stated: 5G free, with 50G, 200G and 2048G paid tiers at 72, 252 and 816 yuan a year

per_object_cap.stated: Not published; the drive is sync-oriented and does not expose a single-file ceiling

retention.stated: Gallery sync and membership termination is staged by region: before December 1, 2022, before January 1, 2023 and before February 1, 2023; transfer windows close by May 31, 2023, June 30, 2023 and July 31, 2023; these services are not terminated on the Chinese mainland at this time

egress.terms: No published cap, and the drive is deliberately not share-oriented: the community notes 不能对外分享. Third-party clients download at full speed with concurrency 20

record.tooling: a reverse-engineered REST interface at i.mi.com with a Go CLI, wangbjun/go-micloud, doing login, list, upload, download, share and tree at concurrency 5 up and 20 down; an unmerged OpenList driver pull request 1391 implements list, link, put and mkdir but its body says 还没写完
record.chaining: The API is real and a wrapper exists, so it would be the cleanest phone-vendor target. 5 GB free means about 410 accounts per 2 TB and the 2 TB tier is CNY 239 to 408 a year, which is not a stacking play

limits.value: 5 GB is the free tier total, which is the cap in practice
family sharing is capped at 8 members and shares quota and not data

identity_cost.detail: A Xiaomi account outside the Chinese mainland can only be created through email; a +86 phone binding identifies a Chinese mainland account

record.reliability_note: Global-region Gallery sync and all memberships were terminated outside mainland China in three regional waves by 2023-02-01, with Gallery data deleted by mid-2023. An email signup works and lands in the region where the product no longer exists, which is a worse outcome than a closed gate because it looks open

evidence.proved: the tier table 免费 5G, 50G, 200G, 2048G at CNY 72, 252 and 816 a year

'Syncing of Gallery items to Xiaomi Cloud and Xiaomi Cloud membership services will be terminated' outside the Chinese mainland, and 'These services will not be terminated on the Chinese mainland at this time'
'The Xiaomi account outside the Chinese mainland can only be created through email'
a full CLI, '登录采用模拟小米云服务Web端的登录逻辑', upload concurrency 5 and download 20

HTTP 200, 102 bytes, {"result":"error","reason":"fileid参数不能为空","code":10016}, which is a 200 that carries an error
HTTP 404, 211 bytes, a Resin/4.0.61 MicloudWeb HTML error page
the notice still says the Gallery sync and membership termination does not apply on the mainland
evidence.quote: These services will not be terminated on the Chinese mainland at this time.

evidence.proved: the notice gives the three regional termination dates
evidence.quote: | Before December 1, 2022 | Before January 1, 2023 | Before February 1, 2023 |

evidence.proved: the portal answers 200 and asks for a Xiaomi Account sign-in

record.price_per_tb_month: unverified: the manual publishes CNY annual prices only
record.binding_note: Free storage is limited to 5 GB. Global email registration routes accounts to international regions where consumer drive sync features have been phased out. Total account quota is the binding constraint.
record.notes: Email registration succeeds internationally but maps accounts to global regions lacking active drive storage sync. Unofficial client tooling includes experimental Go wrapper scripts and community OpenList driver integrations.
